verses.en: O God, why hast thou cast us off for ever? why doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
verses.sm: Atua e, se a le mea ua e lafoaiina mai ai i matou e faavavau? Se a foi le mea e pusa mai ai lou toasa i le lafu mamoe o loo e fagaina?

verses.en: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
verses.sm: la e manatua mai lau faapotopotoga na e faatauina anamua; o le aiga o lou tofi na e faaolaina; o lenei mauga o Siona na e auo ai.

verses.en: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
verses.sm: la e auo ae i mea ua faatafunaina e faavavau; o e na ita mai ua faataumaoi mea uma i le malumalu. Ua pisapisao o e ita te oe i totonu o au faapotopotoga;

verses.en: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.
verses.sm: ua la:ou faatuina o latou faailoga e fai ma faailoga.

verses.en: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
verses.sm: Ua iloa i latou, e pei o tagata ona sii ae o mátau i le vao filifili e tuu ai. O lenei,

verses.en: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
verses.sm: ua uma ai ana mea togitogi, ua lepetia e i latou i matau ma samala. Ua latou susunuina lou malumalu i le au,

verses.en: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
verses.sm: ua latou solia le malumalu o i ai lou suafa, ua oo i le eleele. Ua latou faapea ifo i o latou loto,

verses.en: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
verses.sm: Ia tatou faataumaoi faatasi i latou; ua latou susunuina mea uma i le nuu sa fai ai potopotoga i le Atua. Ua tatou le ¡loa o tatou faailoga;

verses.en: We see not our signs: there is no more any prophet: neither is there among us any that knoweth how long.
verses.sm: e lezi foi se toe perofeta; e leai foi so tatou na te ¡loa pe iu afea nei mea. Le Atua e, e faifai le ua ita mai seia afea?

verses.en: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
verses.sm: Pe faavavau ea ona ‘ino‘ino i lou suafa le ua ita? Se a le mea ua e toe faafoi atu ai lou aao,

verses.en: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.
verses.sm: o lou aao taumatau lava? la e to mai ai nai lou fatafata, ia e faaumatia i latou.

verses.en: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
verses.sm: A o le Atua, o loʻu lea Tupu talu anamua;

verses.en: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
verses.sm: o loo galue e faaola ai i luma o le lalolagi. Na e vaeluaina le sami i lou mana; na e tu‘imomomoina ulu o tanimo o le sami.

verses.en: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
verses.sm: O ulu o leviatana na e nutininii ai lava; na è tuuina atu aj e ‘aina e i latou ua nonofo i nuu naumati.

verses.en: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
verses.sm: O oe lava, na e foaina le vaipuna ma le alia; o o3 lava, na mamate ai vaitafe tafe tetele.

verses.en: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
verses.sm: O loo ia te oe le ao, o loo ia te oe ma le po; o oe lava na e saunia le malamalama ma le la.

verses.en: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
verses.sm: O oe, na e tuuina tuaoi uma o le lalolagi; o le tausaga vevela ma le tausaga maalili, o oe na e faja.

verses.en: Remember this, that the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and that the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
verses.sm: 19 20 21 22 SALAMO 74, la manatua lenei mea, ua faifaia le ALII e i latou ua ita mai;

verses.en: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
verses.sm: o le nuu valea foi ua latou ‘ino‘ino i lou suafa. Aua e te tuuina atu lau manutagi i le manu feai; aua neʻi e faagalogaloina pea o ou tagata ua puapuagaina.

verses.en: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
verses.sm: Ia e manatua le feagaiga; aua ua tutumu mea pouliuli o le lalolagi i mea e nofo ai le saua.

verses.en: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
verses.sm: Aua neʻi foi mai ma le mā le ua sauaina; a ia viia lou suafa e le ua puapuagaina ma le ua mativa.

verses.en: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
verses.sm: Le Atua e, ia e tulai mai, ma e faia lau lava finauga; ia e manatua lou faiga e le tagata valea i aso uma lava.

verses.en: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
verses.sm: Aua ne“ galo ia te oe le leo o e ua ita ia te oe; ua tupu pea lava le vavao o e laga atu ia te oe.
